prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a hand holding a smartphone, with the screen in sharp focus and the background softly blurred, creating a shallow depth of field. The phone displays a social media feed, showing a dark, moody image of a crowded room with people, illuminated by dramatic, low-key lighting. Overlaid on the image in bold, white text are the words "Life is a joke." The hand is positioned so that the thumb is scrolling or about to tap, suggesting a moment of interaction. The color palette is dominated by cool, muted tones with subtle warm highlights reflecting off the skin and the phone, evoking a contemplative, introspective mood. The composition centers the phone and hand, with the background rendered indistinct, drawing all attention to the message on the screen. The overall style is cinematic, reminiscent of a modern drama, with naturalistic lighting and a focus on emotional resonance.
